people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

translations.web: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Chaldea will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And Chaldea shall be a prey: all that prey upon her shall be satisfied, saith Jehovah.
